messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "moistening mouth with sips of water before dosing reduces risk of numbness"
set: ["moistening mouth with sips of water before dosing reduces risk of numbness", "drink a few sips of water first so your mouth is moist", "with a full glass of water", "take with a full glass of water", "take the tablets with a full glass of water", "rinse with water if spray gets in eyes or mouth", "mix tablet with 1 or 2 teaspoons of water", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "minimize risk of sleep disturbances", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "individual risk of cardiovascular events", "start at low end of dosing range", "about a week of once daily dosing", "drink plenty of fluids to reduce risk of dehydration", "take with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "taken with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
